Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000933" [decision]: On 2026-01-22, Team Atlas decided that auth gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour.  (about: Team Atlas, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000742": Team Dune decided the webhooks service will sign payloads with rotating keys because a partner asked for key rotation in their security review.  (about: Team Dune, webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000739" [decision]: On 2025-10-22, Team Dune decided that the webhooks service will sign payloads with rotating keys.  (about: Team Dune, webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000731": The root cause of INC-2025-023 was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk, leaving stale results for two days.  (about: INC-2025-023, reindex job)
- memory_id "1000727": INC-2025-023 was an incident affecting the indexer on 2025-10-13.  (about: indexer, INC-2025-023)
- memory_id "1000592": INC-2025-017's root cause was an expired intermediate certificate, which took logins down.  (about: INC-2025-017, expired intermediate certificate)
- memory_id "1000588": INC-2025-017 was an incident affecting the auth gateway on 2025-07-27.  (about: auth gateway, INC-2025-017)
- memory_id "1000525": As of 2025-06-20, the webhooks service lives with Team Dune, which took it over from Team Atlas.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Dune, webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000522": The Ember team never owned the webhooks service.  (about: webhooks service, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000468": On 2025-05-23, the Ember team flagged that the webhooks service's request volume halved following the client rollout.  (about: webhooks service, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000349": INC-2025-011 was caused by an index missing after the schema migration.  (about: ledger, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000345": During INC-2025-011, the ledger saw write latency spike tenfold for an hour on 2025-04-26.  (about: ledger, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000237" [constraint]: The webhooks service only ships on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000170": The notifier's flat one-second retry was hammering the push provider during its outages.  (about: notifier, push provider)
- memory_id "1000168" [decision]: The notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000156": During INC-2025-004, a stuck offset went unnoticed for 40 minutes.  (about: INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000154": The root cause of INC-2025-004 was a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart.  (about: INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000150": INC-2025-004 was an incident affecting the notifier on 2025-02-06.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000117": The webhooks service depends on the event bus for outbound events.  (about: event bus, webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000114": The notifier depends on the event bus for delivery events.  (about: event bus, notifier)
Existing entity names: Team Atlas, auth gateway, Team Dune, webhooks service, INC-2025-023, reindex job, indexer, INC-2025-017, expired intermediate certificate, Ember team, ledger, INC-2025-011, notifier, push provider, INC-2025-004, event bus

The note:

[2026-01-22] incident-review/INC-2026-003: Incident review INC-2026-003. Webhooks delivered some events twice on 2026-01-17. Root cause: a retry loop that ignored idempotency keys. Decision: webhooks will require an idempotency key on every delivery, because duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 came from retries without one.
